caveats: Review counts are missing for most Google listings: this browser session only receives Google Maps' limited view, which shows the star rating but not the number of reviews.
Four businesses (Falak, Hub City, Hometech, ACE) previously published at domains that are now dead or parked; the website field records what existed, but no live site could be reviewed.
Mehrovinci is the only business in the batch with a working website, so website-quality comparisons across this batch are mostly comparisons of absence.
BBB, BuildZoom and Houzz pages returned HTTP 403 or JS-only shells when fetched directly; details attributed to them come from search-result descriptions of those same URLs.
Where a business is marked 'operating' on directory and licence evidence only, that evidence is third-party listing data, not a first-party confirmation of trading.
data_gaps: No Google Business Profile could be located for B & G Contractors, Central Jersey Construction, MCG Contracting, Micale Construction, Hometech Remodeling or ACE Construction, either by name or by the batch phone number. This may mean no profile exists, or that it uses a different name or phone.
Google Maps review counts were not available in the limited view for any listing.
DuckDuckGo returned a bot challenge, so all discovery used the search tool plus Google Maps directly.

No review text was available to mine for operational complaints (slow replies, missed calls, scheduling trouble) for any business in this batch; operations signals are therefore inferences from missing online intake and should be re-tested in the deep audit.
BBB and BuildZoom pages could not be opened (403), so licence numbers, employee counts and years in business remain as reported by search snippets rather than verified.
